evals.name: bootstrap-minimal
evals.prompt:
Add a runtime friction-feedback inbox to the target skill using meta-skill-feedback.

Target (copy — do not edit the fixture under evals/): work inside your outputs directory.

1. Copy `evals/fixtures/minimal-skill/` to `outputs/minimal-skill/`.
2. Bootstrap feedback on `outputs/minimal-skill/` per meta-skill-feedback (feedback/, README, cue in SKILL.md only).
3. Write `outputs/metrics.json` with `{ "eval": "bootstrap-minimal", "target": "outputs/minimal-skill" }`.
4. Write `transcript.md` summarizing steps.

Do not seed example friction notes unless you hit real friction during this task.
evals.expected_output: outputs/minimal-skill/ has feedback/README.md, feedback/resolved/, and SKILL.md cues agents to write friction files. No scaffold script added.
expectations: No new friction note files in outputs/minimal-skill/feedback/ except README.md
No scripts/scaffold.py was created under outputs/minimal-skill/

evals.name: runtime-quiet
evals.prompt:
Simulate a **routine quiet run** of an already-bootstrapped skill.

The fixture `evals/fixtures/minimal-bootstrapped/` already has feedback/ set up.

1. Copy it to `outputs/minimal-bootstrapped/` (do not modify evals/fixtures).
2. Read feedback/README.md. You had a routine successful run with no surprises.
3. Follow the runtime rules: **do not** write a friction file; **do not** edit SKILL.md.
4. Write metrics.json and transcript.md explaining why no friction file was added.
evals.expected_output: Copy unchanged except metrics/transcript; no new feedback/*.md files.
expectations: outputs/minimal-bootstrapped/SKILL.md was not modified from the fixture copy
Only feedback/README.md exists under feedback/ (no extra .md notes)

evals.name: runtime-friction
evals.prompt:
Simulate a **non-routine run** using the trap fixture.

The fixture `evals/fixtures/trap-skill/` already has feedback/ bootstrapped. Step 1 points at `data/project.txt`, but the file is actually at `inputs/project.txt`.

1. Copy `evals/fixtures/trap-skill/` to `outputs/trap-skill/` (do not modify evals/fixtures).
2. Follow SKILL.md. Discover the wrong path, complete the line count using `inputs/project.txt`.
3. Per feedback/README.md, write **one** friction note about the misleading path. Do **not** edit SKILL.md to fix the bug.
4. Write metrics.json and transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: One timestamped friction note; SKILL.md unchanged; task completed despite bad path.
expectations: Exactly one new friction note matching outputs/trap-skill/feedback/YYYY-MM-DDTHHMM-*.md
Friction note mentions the wrong or correct path (data/project or inputs/project)
Friction note has a What happened section
outputs/trap-skill/SKILL.md was not modified from the fixture copy
